Delete Section 2.1.4 and replace as follows:
2.1.4 Hangers shall be designed to support the suspended loads and shall be a minimum 1/4" (6.4 mm) diameter galvanized steel rods or 1" x 1/8" thick (25 mm x 3.2 mm) flat steel bars. The use of steel wire as a hanger shall not be permitted.
